'''Habadon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. As a flight instructor, Habadon was impressed by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] skills as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. After Solo stunned [[Pter Nyklas]] while freeing the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], Habadon, who now held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]], contacted Solo and persuaded him to turn himself in and testify for his attack on Nyklas.<ref name="EGTWF" />
